verdict.rationale: Cactus publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at /v1/openapi.json and a text API reference at /llms/api covering /generations, /tool_schemas, upload and /billing, and one endpoint (GET /v1/plans) can be called with no key. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive explorer or runnable examples, and the probe found the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths returning 404. The in-browser model demo is a product trial, not an API reference. missing for 10: an interactive API explorer (try-it/Swagger-style UI), runnable code examples per endpoint, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.
